scheme_name: Prime Minister’s Special Scholarship Scheme For The Students Of Union Territories Of Jammu & Kashmir And Ladakh
other_conditions: Applicant must be a domicile of the Union Territories of Jammu & Kashmir or Ladakh.
Must have passed the 12th standard examination from JKBOSE or CBSE‑affiliated schools located in the UTs.
Must secure admission in government colleges/institutions or other select institutions outside the UTs through AICTE counselling under the supernumerary quota (except medical courses).
For lateral entry, the applicant must hold a Diploma in Engineering from a Polytechnic Institute recognized by the Directorate of Technical Education, J&K and Ladakh.
Application must be submitted online on the AICTE web portal.
Admission under the lateral entry scheme is subject to seat availability of the preceding year in the engineering stream.
Scholarships are available for fresh students admitted in the academic session 2022‑23.
Scholarship renewal is contingent on good conduct and attendance as per institution guidelines.
benefits_summary: Scholarship provides up to ₹30,000 academic fee for general degree courses, up to ₹1,25,000 for professional/engineering courses, up to ₹3,00,000 for medical courses, plus a fixed maintenance allowance of ₹1,00,000 per annum.
